title: GOLDEN HOUR
summary: Wave survival on the unfinished top floor of a high-rise at sunset.
description: A first-person wave-survival shooter built by Claude Haiku 5.5 in Claude Code at max effort, from the same high-rise shooter prompt as the Highrise Protocol builds. Fight rushers, gunners and armoured heavies with a full-auto rifle; sprint, slide, mantle, lean and aim down sights, and regenerate health behind cover. Three.js with no build step: textures, sounds and music are generated at startup, with a sun shadow map, volumetric light shafts, bloom and filmic grading. The session log records 215 requests in about 58 minutes, including two subagents: 107.3M input tokens (106.1M of them cache reads) and 1.25M output tokens, roughly $7.85 at API list prices. Packaged unchanged with relative asset URLs.
